properties.name: Son (Hiranyavaha)
properties.subtitle: The Ancient Golden Sands Tributary of the Ganges
properties.heritage_sites: Bansagar Dam, Deori, Rohtasgarh Fort, Koilwar Bridge (historic 1862 rail-road bridge)
properties.cultural_significance: Ancient 'Hiranyavaha' (bearer of gold) in Sanskrit literature. Second-largest southern tributary of Ganga, featured in Megasthenes' chronicles of Pataliputra.

properties.name: Betwa (Vetravati)
properties.subtitle: The Royal River of Bundelkhand & Buddhist Heritage
properties.origin: Vindhya Range, Raisen district, Madhya Pradesh
properties.basin: Yamuna River near Hamirpur, Uttar Pradesh
properties.heritage_sites: Bhojpur Shiva Temple, Sanchi Buddhist Stupas, Vidisha, Orchha Cenotaphs & Raja Mahal, Deogarh
properties.cultural_significance: Flows past the majestic UNESCO world heritage Buddhist monuments at Sanchi and the grand medieval riverside cenotaphs and palaces of Orchha.

properties.name: Ravi (Iravati / Purushni)
properties.subtitle: The Vedic River of Chamba & Majha
properties.origin: Bara Bhangal, Dhauladhar Range, Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
properties.heritage_sites: Chamba Valley, Ranjit Sagar Dam, Madhopur headworks, Dera Baba Nanak
properties.cultural_significance: Site of the historic Battle of the Ten Kings (Dasarajna) described in the Rigveda. Nourishes the traditional Chamba Rumal embroidery culture and the rich folk arts of Punjab.

properties.name: Gandak (Narayani / Saligrami)
properties.subtitle: The Sacred River of Shaligram Stones & Vaishali
properties.heritage_sites: Valmiki National Park, Kushinagar (Mahaparinirvana), Vaishali ancient republic, Sonpur Cattle Fair (Harihar Kshetra)
properties.cultural_significance: Famed for bearing the naturally formed sacred Shaligram Ammonite stones worshipped by Hindus. Joins Ganga at Sonpur, the site of Asia's largest ancient heritage fair.

properties.name: Godavari (Dakshin Ganga)
properties.subtitle: The Sacred Ganges of Southern India
properties.heritage_sites: Trimbakeshwar Shiva Jyotirlinga, Nashik Kumbh Ghats, Nanded Hazur Sahib, Basar Saraswati Temple, Bhadrachalam Rama Temple, Rajahmundry
properties.cultural_significance: The second longest river in India and largest peninsular river. Hosts the sacred Nashik Kumbh Mela and Godavari Pushkaram every 12 years; sanctified by the Sage Gautama.

properties.name: Sutlej (Shatadru)
properties.subtitle: The Raging Snow-Fed Artery of Punjab & Himachal
properties.heritage_sites: Kinnaur Valley, Rampur Bushahr, Bilaspur, Bhakra Nangal Dam, Anandpur Sahib, Harike Wetland
properties.cultural_significance: The easternmost of Punjab's historic five rivers. Powers the Bhakra Nangal Dam and sustains the fertile agricultural grain belt of North-West India.

properties.name: Sutlej (Shatadru)
properties.subtitle: The Raging Snow-Fed Artery of Punjab & Himachal
properties.heritage_sites: Kinnaur Valley, Rampur Bushahr, Bilaspur, Bhakra Nangal Dam, Anandpur Sahib, Harike Wetland
properties.cultural_significance: The easternmost of Punjab's historic five rivers. Powers the Bhakra Nangal Dam and sustains the fertile agricultural grain belt of North-West India.

properties.name: Mahanadi (The Great River)
properties.subtitle: The Lifeline of Odisha & Chhattisgarh
properties.heritage_sites: Rajim (Triveni Sangam of CG), Sirpur Buddhist site, Hirakud Dam, Sambalpur Samaleswari, Cuttack Barabati Fort
properties.cultural_significance: Nourishes the rich Sambalpuri ikat weaving tradition, ancient temples of Sirpur, and hosts Hirakud Dam—one of the earliest and longest major multipurpose dams in post-independence India.

properties.name: Mahanadi (The Great River)
properties.subtitle: The Lifeline of Odisha & Chhattisgarh
properties.heritage_sites: Rajim (Triveni Sangam of CG), Sirpur Buddhist site, Hirakud Dam, Sambalpur Samaleswari, Cuttack Barabati Fort
properties.cultural_significance: Nourishes the rich Sambalpuri ikat weaving tradition, ancient temples of Sirpur, and hosts Hirakud Dam—one of the earliest and longest major multipurpose dams in post-independence India.

properties.name: Krishna (Krishnaveni)
properties.subtitle: The Lifeblood of the Deccan Plateau
properties.heritage_sites: Mahabaleshwar, Wai temples, Narsobawadi, Almatti, Nagarjuna Sagar, Amaravati Stupa, Vijayawada Kanaka Durga Temple
properties.cultural_significance: Nourishes the historic kingdoms of the Deccan and ancient Buddhist heritage at Amaravati and Nagarjunakonda. Celebrated for rich black-soil agriculture and historic Krishna Pushkaralu.

properties.name: Krishna (Krishnaveni)
properties.subtitle: The Lifeblood of the Deccan Plateau
properties.heritage_sites: Mahabaleshwar, Wai temples, Narsobawadi, Almatti, Nagarjuna Sagar, Amaravati Stupa, Vijayawada Kanaka Durga Temple
properties.cultural_significance: Nourishes the historic kingdoms of the Deccan and ancient Buddhist heritage at Amaravati and Nagarjunakonda. Celebrated for rich black-soil agriculture and historic Krishna Pushkaralu.

properties.name: Yamuna
properties.subtitle: The Sacred Daughter of Surya & River of Braj
properties.basin: Confluence with Ganga at Triveni Sangam, Prayagraj
properties.heritage_sites: Yamunotri, Paonta Sahib, Mathura, Vrindavan, Taj Mahal & Agra Fort, Bateshwar, Prayagraj Sangam
properties.cultural_significance: Deeply intertwined with the legends of Lord Krishna's youth in Gokul and Vrindavan. Flows past iconic monuments including the Taj Mahal and meets Ganga at the mystical Triveni Sangam.

properties.name: Narmada (Reva)
properties.subtitle: The Unbroken Spirit of Central India
properties.heritage_sites: Amarkantak, Bhedaghat Marble Rocks, Dhuandhar Falls, Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga, Maheshwar Ahilya Fort, Statue of Unity
properties.cultural_significance: One of only two major west-flowing rivers, flowing through a tectonic rift valley between Vindhya and Satpura ranges. Renowned for the sacred 2,600 km 'Narmada Parikrama' circumambulation.

properties.name: Chenab (Chandra-Bhaga / Asikni)
properties.subtitle: River of Romance & Himalayan Canyons
properties.origin: Baralacha La Pass (Chandra & Bhaga confluence), Lahaul-Spiti, HP
properties.heritage_sites: Tandi Confluence, Kishtwar, Doda, Chenab Railway Bridge (World's highest rail bridge at Reasi), Akhnoor Fort
properties.cultural_significance: Celebrated in classical Punjabi Sufi literature as the waters of eternal love in the ballads of Heer-Ranjha and Sohni-Mahiwal. Spanned by the engineering marvel of the Chenab Arch Bridge.

properties.name: Jhelum (Vitasta / Vyeth)
properties.subtitle: The Romantic Serenade of the Kashmir Valley
properties.origin: Verinag Spring, Pir Panjal Range, Anantnag, Kashmir
properties.heritage_sites: Verinag Mughal Garden, Avantipura ruins, Srinagar Old Bridges (Kadals), Dal Lake channels, Wular Lake
properties.cultural_significance: Known as Vitasta in the Rigveda and Hydaspes to the Greeks. Flowing like a serene serpentine ribbon through Srinagar, shaping the iconic wooden shikara and houseboat culture of Kashmir.

properties.name: Jhelum (Vitasta / Vyeth)
properties.subtitle: The Romantic Serenade of the Kashmir Valley
properties.origin: Verinag Spring, Pir Panjal Range, Anantnag, Kashmir
properties.heritage_sites: Verinag Mughal Garden, Avantipura ruins, Srinagar Old Bridges (Kadals), Dal Lake channels, Wular Lake
properties.cultural_significance: Known as Vitasta in the Rigveda and Hydaspes to the Greeks. Flowing like a serene serpentine ribbon through Srinagar, shaping the iconic wooden shikara and houseboat culture of Kashmir.

properties.name: Kaveri (Cauvery / Ponni)
properties.subtitle: The Golden Maiden of Tamil & Kannada Heritage
properties.heritage_sites: Talakaveri, Bhagamandala, Ranganathaswamy (Srirangapatna), Shivanasamudra Falls, Hogenakkal Falls, Srirangam, Thanjavur Brihadisvara, Kumbakonam
properties.cultural_significance: Revered in ancient Sangam epics (Silappadikaram) as 'Ponni' (the golden river). The cradle of Carnatic classical music, Chola bronze metallurgy, and fertile rice fields of Thanjavur.

properties.name: Kaveri (Cauvery / Ponni)
properties.subtitle: The Golden Maiden of Tamil & Kannada Heritage
properties.heritage_sites: Talakaveri, Bhagamandala, Ranganathaswamy (Srirangapatna), Shivanasamudra Falls, Hogenakkal Falls, Srirangam, Thanjavur Brihadisvara, Kumbakonam
properties.cultural_significance: Revered in ancient Sangam epics (Silappadikaram) as 'Ponni' (the golden river). The cradle of Carnatic classical music, Chola bronze metallurgy, and fertile rice fields of Thanjavur.

properties.name: Chambal (Charmanvati)
properties.subtitle: The Pristine Sanctuary of Central Badlands
properties.origin: Janapav, Vindhya Range, Mhow, Madhya Pradesh
properties.basin: Yamuna River near Etawah, Uttar Pradesh
properties.heritage_sites: Gandhi Sagar Dam, Rawatbhata, Kota Garh Palace, Keshoraipatan, National Chambal Sanctuary
properties.cultural_significance: Considered one of India's cleanest and most unpolluted rivers, shielded from intense industrialization by legend. A vital sanctuary for the critically endangered Gharial crocodile and Gangetic dolphin.

properties.name: Chambal (Charmanvati)
properties.subtitle: The Pristine Sanctuary of Central Badlands
properties.origin: Janapav, Vindhya Range, Mhow, Madhya Pradesh
properties.basin: Yamuna River near Etawah, Uttar Pradesh
properties.heritage_sites: Gandhi Sagar Dam, Rawatbhata, Kota Garh Palace, Keshoraipatan, National Chambal Sanctuary
properties.cultural_significance: Considered one of India's cleanest and most unpolluted rivers, shielded from intense industrialization by legend. A vital sanctuary for the critically endangered Gharial crocodile and Gangetic dolphin.

properties.name: Ghaghara (Saryu / Karnali)
properties.subtitle: The Holy Saryu of Ayodhya & Ramayana Legacy
properties.origin: Mapchachungo Glacier near Lake Mansarovar, Tibet
properties.basin: Ganga River at Revelganj, Chhapra, Bihar
properties.heritage_sites: Dudhwa National Park, Ayodhya Ram Ki Paidi & Ghats, Faizabad, Chhapra
properties.cultural_significance: Known reverently as the sacred Saryu in Ayodhya, central to the life and reign of Lord Rama in the Ramayana. The largest tributary of the Ganges by volume.

properties.name: Brahmaputra (Luit / Tsangpo)
properties.subtitle: Son of Brahma • The Red River of the North-East
properties.origin: Angsi Glacier, Mount Kailash region, Tibet
properties.basin: Bay of Bengal via Meghna Estuary
properties.heritage_sites: Pasighat, Dibrugarh, Majuli Island (World's largest river island), Kaziranga National Park, Kamakhya Temple (Guwahati)
properties.cultural_significance: One of the rare male rivers in Indian sacred geography. Nurtures the biodiversity of Kaziranga, the Neo-Vaishnavite Satra monasteries of Majuli, and inspiring Assamese folk ballads by Bhupen Hazarika.

properties.name: Bhima (Chandrabhaga)
properties.subtitle: The Spiritual Stream of the Varkari Saints
properties.origin: Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga, Western Ghats, Pune, Maharashtra
properties.heritage_sites: Bhimashankar Temple, Pandharpur Vithoba Temple, Ganagapur Dattatreya Temple
properties.cultural_significance: Flows in a crescent moon shape past Pandharpur where it is celebrated as Chandrabhaga by millions of Varkari pilgrims singing Abhangas of Sant Tukaram and Dnyaneshwar.

properties.name: Teesta
properties.subtitle: The Emerald Glacial Jewel of the Eastern Himalayas
properties.origin: Pahunri / Tso Lhamo Lake, North Sikkim
properties.heritage_sites: Lachen, Chungthang, Singtam, Kalimpong hills, Sevoke Coronation Bridge, Jalpaiguri
properties.cultural_significance: Sacred to the Lepcha indigenous people of Sikkim as the goddess of nature. Carves dramatic deep mountain gorges across the Himalayan foothills.

properties.name: Tapti (Tapi)
properties.subtitle: The Sun-Daughter of Central & Western Ghats
properties.origin: Multai, Betul district, Satpura Range, Madhya Pradesh
properties.heritage_sites: Multai sacred tank, Burhanpur Asirgarh Fort, Melghat, Surat historic port
properties.cultural_significance: Vedic river daughter of Surya, flowing westward parallel to Narmada. Historic artery connecting ancient central Indian trade routes to the diamond and silk port of Surat.

properties.name: Ganga (The Sacred Ganges)
properties.subtitle: The Divine Lifeline of Indian Civilization
properties.heritage_sites: Gangotri, Devprayag, Rishikesh, Haridwar, Prayagraj (Sangam), Varanasi Ghats, Patna, Dakshineswar
properties.cultural_significance: Revered as the holy mother 'Ganga Mata' in Indian traditions. Host to the world's largest spiritual gathering, the Maha Kumbh Mela, the evening Ganga Aarti of Varanasi and Haridwar, and sacred Chhath celebrations.

properties.name: Penna (Pennar / Pinakini)
properties.subtitle: The Sculptor of the Gandikota Grand Canyon
properties.basin: Bay of Bengal at Utukuru, Andhra Pradesh
properties.heritage_sites: Nandi Hills, Lepakshi Veerabhadra Temple, Gandikota Gorge (Grand Canyon of India), Nellore
properties.cultural_significance: Carves the breathtaking red quartzite gorge of Gandikota and flows through the historic cultural heartlands of Rayalaseema and coastal Andhra.

properties.name: Indus (Sindhu)
properties.subtitle: The Ancient Cradle of Indian Civilization
properties.heritage_sites: Leh, Shey Palace, Alchi Monastery, Indus-Zanskar Confluence (Sangam, Nimmu)
properties.cultural_significance: Gave India and the subcontinent their timeless names (Sindhu -> Hindu -> India). Celebrated in the Rigveda as the mighty Sindhu, carving dramatic granite gorges through high-altitude Ladakh.

properties.name: Indus (Sindhu)
properties.subtitle: The Ancient Cradle of Indian Civilization
properties.heritage_sites: Leh, Shey Palace, Alchi Monastery, Indus-Zanskar Confluence (Sangam, Nimmu)
properties.cultural_significance: Gave India and the subcontinent their timeless names (Sindhu -> Hindu -> India). Celebrated in the Rigveda as the mighty Sindhu, carving dramatic granite gorges through high-altitude Ladakh.

properties.name: Beas (Vipasha)
properties.subtitle: The Mountain Jewel of the Valley of the Gods
properties.origin: Beas Kund, Rohtang Pass, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
properties.basin: Sutlej River at Harike Pattan, Punjab
properties.heritage_sites: Manali, Naggar Castle, Kullu Valley, Mandi (Choti Kashi), Pong Dam Lake sanctuary, Harike Wetland
properties.cultural_significance: Marked the easternmost boundary of Alexander the Great's world campaign in 326 BCE. Revered for pure glacial waters supporting endangered Indus river dolphins at Harike.

properties.name: Beas (Vipasha)
properties.subtitle: The Mountain Jewel of the Valley of the Gods
properties.origin: Beas Kund, Rohtang Pass, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
properties.basin: Sutlej River at Harike Pattan, Punjab
properties.heritage_sites: Manali, Naggar Castle, Kullu Valley, Mandi (Choti Kashi), Pong Dam Lake sanctuary, Harike Wetland
properties.cultural_significance: Marked the easternmost boundary of Alexander the Great's world campaign in 326 BCE. Revered for pure glacial waters supporting endangered Indus river dolphins at Harike.

properties.name: Tungabhadra (Pampa)
properties.subtitle: The Sacred Mirror of Vijayanagara Splendor
properties.origin: Confluence of Tunga and Bhadra at Koodli, Shimoga, Karnataka
properties.heritage_sites: Koodli Sangam, Harihar, Hampi UNESCO World Heritage Monuments, Tungabhadra Dam (Hosapete), Alampur Jogulamba Temple
properties.cultural_significance: Revered as Pampa in the Ramayana where Lord Rama met Sugriva and Hanuman at Kishkindha. Flowed past the majestic palaces and stone chariot of the Vijayanagara Empire.

properties.name: Tungabhadra (Pampa)
properties.subtitle: The Sacred Mirror of Vijayanagara Splendor
properties.origin: Confluence of Tunga and Bhadra at Koodli, Shimoga, Karnataka
properties.heritage_sites: Koodli Sangam, Harihar, Hampi UNESCO World Heritage Monuments, Tungabhadra Dam (Hosapete), Alampur Jogulamba Temple
properties.cultural_significance: Revered as Pampa in the Ramayana where Lord Rama met Sugriva and Hanuman at Kishkindha. Flowed past the majestic palaces and stone chariot of the Vijayanagara Empire.

properties.name: Sabarmati
properties.subtitle: The Peaceful Stream of the Freedom Struggle
properties.heritage_sites: Dharoi Dam, Gandhinagar, Sabarmati Ashram (Ahmedabad), Dandi March Route
properties.cultural_significance: The historical nerve-center of Mahatma Gandhi's Satyagraha movement. Provided the spiritual backdrop for the iconic 1930 Dandi Salt March and Gujarat's cultural identity.

properties.name: Periyar
properties.subtitle: The Lush Lifeline of God's Own Country
properties.origin: Sivagiri Hills, Western Ghats, Kerala-Tamil Nadu border
properties.basin: Vembanad Lake / Arabian Sea at Kodungallur
properties.heritage_sites: Periyar Tiger Reserve, Thekkady, Idukki Arch Dam, Kalady (Adi Shankara birthplace), Aluva Shiva Temple
properties.cultural_significance: The longest river in Kerala and its economic and cultural backbone. Flowing past the birthplace of philosopher Adi Shankaracharya at Kalady and host to the Aluva Sivarathri festival.
